dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D tapering from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth lateral margins with a slight asymmetrical bulge on the left lateral edge (animal's right side).

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone, appearing as high-intensity white on the illuminated right side and medium-grey on the shadowed left side.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct vertical linear mark on the right dorsal flank and a small dark focal point near the midline shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single vertical linear scar or rake mark located on the right dorsal surface.
